sample_name: near-threshold voltage dip with assist limitation
event_pattern: Assist limitation or reduced assist occurs near a short voltage dip, but no permanent under-voltage DTC is latched.
soft_deviation_to_capture: repeated short voltage dips, near-reset context, assist limit co-occurrence, key-cycle recurrence
existing_monitor_boundary: Existing under/over-voltage DTC and reset monitor may already detect hard events; value remains only below persistence threshold or when context is not retained.
additional_log_trigger: Store voltage min/max, dip duration class, reset counter delta, assist mode, DTC status, key cycle, recurrence count.
diagnostic_reading_order: 1 event summary, 2 EPS DTC status, 3 voltage dip context, 4 assist mode/limit state, 5 key-cycle recurrence, 6 repair feedback requirement.
quality_feedback: Field trend of near-threshold power events that correlate with assist limitation; request power-system repair result and recurrence after repair.
customer_explanation: Power context may affect assist availability; inspect power context before EPS component judgment.
proceed_signal: Soft voltage context changes reading order and can be stored without claiming root cause.
hold_or_stop_signal: Hold if voltage history is not stored, event persistence is unavailable, or existing voltage DTC already covers all useful cases.
what_not_to_claim: Power cause断定、EPS無罪断定、交換時期、安全保証、保証費削減を言わない。
next_action: Create a one-page sample log schema and review with diagnosis planning.

sample_name: intermittent external signal invalid with steering message
event_pattern: Steering message or assist fallback appears near intermittent external-signal invalid/timeout, but no hard communication DTC is stable.
soft_deviation_to_capture: intermittent invalid flag, timeout counter increase, repeated fallback entry, mismatch between signal validity and steering message
existing_monitor_boundary: Existing timeout/bus-off/invalid-value DTC may already identify hard faults; value remains when intermittent dependency context is not retained.
additional_log_trigger: Store dependency signal name, validity status, timeout/alive counter, fallback state, steering message, related DTC, key-cycle recurrence.
diagnostic_reading_order: 1 event summary, 2 steering DTC/message, 3 dependency signal status, 4 timeout/alive counter, 5 fallback state, 6 related external/network DTC, 7 explanation boundary.
quality_feedback: Field trend of dependency instability that drives service confusion or customer complaints; request external ECU/network repair result and recurrence.
customer_explanation: EPS response may depend on external signal validity; validate dependency context before steering component judgment.
proceed_signal: Dependency snapshot prevents EPS-internal fault shortcut and improves customer/service explanation.
hold_or_stop_signal: Stop if EPS supplier cannot define the dependency signal, fallback behavior, or steering-side effect.
what_not_to_claim: 外部ECU root cause、EPS問題なし、交換時期、安全保証、保証責任断定を言わない。
next_action: Create a signal dependency snapshot sample and review with diagnosis/customer technical teams.
